needsARealService: Changing the address book belongs to the Import Notification Service frontend: it already has this API (list, add, read, change and delete an address) and is the address book’s only writer. Plants-frontend only reads it. These pages need to move there, or plants-frontend needs agreement to write to the address book.

operations.name: listAddresses

params.q: text to find in the name or address

errors: 400 when the page is out of range

operations.name: createAddress
operations.returns: the saved address, with its new id
errors: 400 with a problem body, { errors: { field: [message] } }, for each field it refuses

operations.name: getAddress
operations.returns: address; a deleted one comes back with deleted: true
errors: 404 when the organisation has no such address

operations.name: updateAddress
errors: 404 when there is no such address

openQuestions: Should these pages live in the Import Notification Service frontend, which owns the address book?
Does the address book need anything a design adds, such as categories or usages?
notes: CDP dev has no backend for this service, so index.js keeps isStubDataMode() to choose stub.js until plants-frontend writes to the real address book.

client.js follows the same request shape as trade-imports-ins-frontend's own address book client (src/server/app/services/address-book/client.js): same paths, same headers, same problem-body shape. It is a sibling implementation kept in step by a shape-drift test, not a copy that is claimed to be byte-identical.
